_notes: Local CI targets for Jacques's Portfolio (app/scripts/ci-runner.ts).
petclinic (spring-petclinic-microservices, Java 17) runs every module's tests with Maven.
ghostfolio is an Nx monorepo with about 1.5 GB of dependencies; its target is marked heavy and runs only with --heavy or --target api-jest, for the api project.

targets.name: maven
targets.note: all eight modules; surefire reports collected

targets.name: api-jest
targets.run: (npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error) && npm install --no-save --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error jest-junit && (JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_DIR=/out JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_NAME=jest.xml npx nx run api:test --ci --reporters=default --reporters=jest-junit 2>&1 | tee /out/jest.log; echo "nx exit $?")
